title: UFO professor privately agrees UFOs aren't from other planets

tellings.quote: and anyways I'm I'm with him at some conference where like by the bar and I'm like I'm like if you actually use inductive logic these things are not from other planets and he like looks at me and he sort of like Whispers and he's like you're right

plain: A professor known for studying UFOs privately admitted that he does not think they come from other planets, according to Michels, who says it happened to him at a conference around 2019 or 2020. Michels tells it himself, without naming the professor: at the bar he said that by inductive logic these things are not from other planets, and the professor looked at him and whispered, "you're right." It would mean that some experts believe more than they say in public.
